Quick technical notes from infra:

- The KV cache miss was triggered by an uncommitted configuration push on 11/15; that change has been reverted, but we observed trailing cold-start latency for ~18 hours. Root cause: config rollout did not fully warm the prefix cache for the dedicated pool (policy bug).
- Proposed mitigation: update rollout policy to warm prefixes and add a short-lived traffic shadow for new configs. I'll target a patch by EOD 12/01.

Suggested exec ask: ask Acme to approve a short maintenance window (1-2 hours) so we can apply the prefix warmup to their dedicated capacity — this reduces perceived risk immediately and is low customer effort.
